<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="ex46032023-02-1416-08-10" type="excerpt" status="unreviewed">

            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">lugs gnyis pa ni | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kho bo</rs>'i bla ma</rs>'i gsung sgros ste | 'di ltar bum 'dzin rtog pa la bum par snang ba ni bum 'dzin rtog pa'i gzung rnam yin te | bum pa de khyod yin pa'i phyir | bum 'dzin rtog pa'i gzung rnam ni | bum 'dzin rtog pa la bum par snang ba min te | yin na sngon 'dzin <lb n="2b7"/> mngon sum gyi bzung rnam yang sngon 'dzin mngon sum la sngon por snang ba'i phyir ro || des na rtog pa la phyi rol du snang ba ni don spyi yin gyi | rtog pa'i gzung rnam ma yin no || de bzhin du zla ba gnyis snang gi dbang shes la zla gnyis su snang ba'i rnam pa 'di ni dngos por med kyang dbang shes 'di'i snang yul yin gyi [\[]bzung [;]gzung [\]]rnam yin la | sngon 'dzin mngon sum la sngon por snang ba 'di ni sngon po rang mtshan yin gyi | sngon 'dzin mngon sum gyi [\[]bzung [;]gzung [\]]rnam ni ma yin te | de bzung rnam yin zhing | de las [\<lb n="2b8"/> gzhan du phyi rol gyi don [xxx ]'dod na mi 'thad de | de 'dra'i phyi rol gyi don yod na mngon sum gyis dmigs rung la [xx]dmigs pa'i phyir dang | <rs type="school">grangs can pa</rs> 'dod pa ltar gyi yul bar du blo'am chen po zhes pa'i dngos po khas len rigs par yin pa'i phyir dang | sngon 'dzin mngon sum de rang gi gzung rnam sngon po ma yin bzhin du sngon por snang na 'khrul shes su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro || des na sngon por snang ba de ni yul yin la | gzung rnam ni rang la sngon po'i rnam pa shar nas sngon po <lb n="2b9"/> la kha phyir phyogs ste 'jal byed du zhugs pa'i blo nyid la bzhed do || 
            'dir ni blo rang la sngon po'i rnam pa shar zer kyang blo rang gis sngon po mthong ba la byed dgos pa 'dra'o || 
            'dis rtog pa dang zla ba gnyis snang sogs kyi bzung rnam yang shes par bya'o || 
         </seg></TEI>
